shortcut_name: three-step bottleneck is exactly a triangle
evidence: deepseek: "if b in adj[a]" and "common neighbors"; gpt-oss: "for a, b in edges" followed by computing common neighbors; both directly search for three mutually colliding steps
affordance_in_statement: A subset of exactly three steps is considered an unresolvable bottleneck if all 8 possible ways of assigning these three steps to the two production lines result in at least one tool collision between a pair of steps within the subset.
removal_suggestion: There is no semantics-preserving edit that removes this shortcut: for exactly three vertices and two lines, failure of every assignment is mathematically equivalent to all three pairs being collision edges. Avoiding it would require changing the bottleneck predicate or the number/allocation model, which changes the task.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Recognizes that the required group is a triangle and searches edges for a common neighbor in lexicographic order.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: all 8 assignments of exactly three steps must cause a collision

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Recognizes the same triangle condition and uses sorted edges plus bitset common-neighbor checks.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: all 8 assignments of exactly three steps must cause a collision

common_affordance: For three steps assigned to two lines, every assignment fails exactly when each of the three step pairs is a collision edge, so the target is a triangle in the collision graph.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It correctly searches for triangles but enumerates all three-step combinations, which is too slow for n up to 2000.
It searches for a triangle in the complement graph, treating non-colliding pairs as the required relation instead of collision pairs.

recommended_edit: No valid single edit can defeat both surviving approaches without changing the problem's mathematical task; the triangle characterization is an intrinsic structural floor.
